title: Expect-CT header absent (deprecated header, informational)
description: Expect-CT is a deprecated response header. Chromium deprecated it from version 107, and browsers enforce Certificate Transparency without it. Its absence does not weaken a current browser. This informational check is kept so the deprecated header is not reintroduced as a requirement.
remediation: No action is required on the response itself: Expect-CT was deprecated because browsers no longer act on it, so its absence is expected and is reported for inventory completeness only. Durable: remove the header from any configuration template that still sets it so a future deployment does not reintroduce a directive nothing enforces, and police Certificate Transparency from the CT logs or from your certificate monitoring instead. Trade-off: if you previously relied on Expect-CT report-only to detect mis-issued certificates, that signal has to move to a CT-log monitor before the header is removed.
limitation: Header-name check on a deprecated header. Absence is not a current weakness.
